content.intro: This lesson introduces decorators as part of advanced python language features. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: A good function has a clear contract: inputs, output, side effects, and failure behavior. Keep one responsibility in each function and test important edge cases.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A decorator takes a callable or class and returns a wrapped or otherwise transformed object.
